messages:
tara: FYI we had another customer stumble on SDK errors during onboarding. They saw an "invalid_credentials" body but SDK surfaced BadRequestError with message '400: bad request' only. No helpful hint.
felix: Oof. That's the mapping problem we discussed. Are we only using status code mapping in the client libs?
tara: Yep, most clients map by status code first. The server emits machine codes in body.error and sometimes a human message. We should prioritize the body code.
anya: Agreed. Minimal proposal: when response Content-Type == application/json, parse body first and look for known error codes, then fall back to status code. Also attach a "retryable" boolean and a "user_action" hint string in the typed exception.
sam: From support: customers copy/paste the error into our onboarding flow and the UI has no guidance. If we included user_action like "reauth" or "contact-support" it would reduce tickets.
dev-bot: [ci] go-sdk tests failing: error_mapping_test.go:42 expected RefreshTokenMissingError but got BadRequestError. https://ci.redwood.internal/5678
felix: I'll take go-sdk. Quick notes: go error type currently is:
```
type APIError struct { StatusCode int; Message string }
```
We should extend to:
```
type APIError struct { StatusCode int; Code string; Message string; Retryable bool; Suggestion string }
```
But keep backwards compatibility by implementing Error() the same.
tara: For languages that don't have typed exceptions (JS/old SDKs), return an error object with fields and include a top-level 'code' string. Do not rely only on message text for classification.
anya: We also need consistent human-friendly copy. Avoid raw backend messages like "invalid_credentials" in UI. Map codes to friendly strings in a central table: e.g., invalid_credentials -> "Your session expired. Please sign in again." and include an action "prompt_reauth".
felix: Implementation approach: add a small middleware in the HTTP client stack that does:
1) if json body and body.error in mapping table => build typed error with mapping metadata
2) else if 4xx => BadRequestError, 5xx => ServerError with Retry-After parsing
3) include raw_body for debug but not show in UI
I'll open a PR for go and add cross-SDK spec in docs.
dev-bot: [ops] incident 2025-03-11T10:12Z: auth-service returning 502 for ~3m. Some onboarding flows hit combined auth failure and returned opaque errors.
tara: That's the edge case: auth service transient 502 combined with expired tokens can make the client retry path ambiguous. SDK should prefer auth-related user-action over automated retry when body.code signals auth.
sam: Can we add sample-app testcases? I'd like tests for:
- expired refresh token -> RefreshTokenMissingError -> UI shows reauth
- expired token + auth service 502 on refresh -> show reauth (not spinner)
- server 503 with Retry-After -> retryable ServerError
anya: I'll author a test matrix in sample-apps and include expected typed errors. Also will draft a small section in onboarding docs mapping codes -> UX.
felix: Ping me when tests land. I'll modify go-sdk error types and add fixtures. Expect PR tomorrow.
tara: Owners: felix (go-sdk), anya (spec + sample-apps), sam (onboarding UX copy). Mark as p1. I'll follow up with a short RFC for the mapping file format.
